problem_statement: The PSA cryptography library must be initialized automatically at startup when it is included in an application, so that PSA cryptographic operations can be used directly. Currently, operations such as ciphers, hashes, MACs, ECDSA and EDDSA do not work unless the application explicitly initializes the library before using it.

verification.reason: The statement clearly asks for automatic startup initialization of the PSA crypto library when it is included, and the repository already provides the RIOT auto-init mechanism needed to implement this. The hidden tests only remove explicit psa_crypto_init calls and rely on that behavior, which a competent developer can infer and implement.
